notes: ✨ New: GlowSpark, a tiny AI we built and trained from scratch. It writes old-style fairy tales right on your device
No account, no key and no WebGPU needed: it is plain JavaScript, and it keeps working offline after your first visit
Tap any word to see the other words it considered, and pick one to send the story another way
The page shows its measured size, speed and test score, including where it loses to big AI models
Find it on Glow home, in the Glow apps menu, or type an opening line and choose ✨ Tiny AI
